title: PofBC — verified vector logo recoveries
method: Original published SVGs or exact native vector artwork isolated from published SVG/PDF sources. No raster tracing, redrawn symbols or substituted typefaces. PDF print colours are converted to sRGB; source-matched conversions are recorded in the research evidence.
datePolicy: A report date, archived capture or bundle date establishes a specimen date. It does not establish adoption or first use.

assets.label: bccie 2022 source vector
assets.provenance: Official publication, original native vector paths extracted; not a supplied standalone master.
assets.dateMeaning: Publication/capture date or observation, not an adoption date.
assets.notes: Full BCCIE logo from the official 2022-2025 strategic plan; dated sighting, not an assertion of adoption date.
assets.method: PyMuPDF PDF-to-SVG conversion, preserving exact selected source path nodes and all ancestor transforms; unrelated paths, text, raster images, and unused definitions removed. No tracing, type recreation, or recolouring.
assets.colourNote: PDF colours converted to SVG RGB by PyMuPDF. No manual palette replacement. ICC/CMYK conversion can differ from colour-managed PDF rendering; especially the full-colour Infrastructure BC green.
